title: Concrete strength greater than 12,000 psi.
officialText:
For columns made with concrete having a specified
compressive strength, f’ , greater than 12,000 psi (82.7 MPa), for fire-resistance ratings of 1 hour to 4 hours the
c
minimum dimension shall be 24 inches (610 mm).
